extract: Ashley Elizabeth Hinson is an American politician, and former broadcast journalist, serving as the U.S. representative for Iowa's 2nd congressional district since 2021. A member of the Republican Party, she was a member of the Iowa House of Representatives for the 67th district from 2017 to 2021.
